Silver (Japanese: 銀次郎 Ginjirō) is a character who appeared in Pokémon Pocket Monsters. He is a rival of .

==History==
Silver debuted in Welcome Back, Clefairy!!, where he was recommended to along with by Professor Elm to travel around the Johto region and complete the Pokédex. Starting off with a Totodile, Silver receives his hand-held device, a Pokédex, and sets off. During that time, he meets who tells him the basics of training. Unlike the games, he does not steal Totodile but got that honor. He makes a cameo in the next chapter in Professor Elm's flashback.

In Clefairy, the Battle Instructor, Silver has his Totodile battle . During the battle, Clefairy uses a vehicle powered up by to chase Silver and Totodile away.

In Pokémon Snowball Fight, he competes in a race with Red's other rivals. During the race, he does not make it onward after threw him off course with his . Silver reappeared in Return light to Bellossom!! where he helps Red fight off a .

==Personality==
Silver is very different from his game counterpart, as he did not steal the first partner Pokémon that had a type advantage to Gold's. Also, he is seen being friendly to Red most of the time in contrast to Red's rivals in Kanto.
